description: I am a passionate and ambitious student with a strong interest in science, mathematics, technology, and space exploration. My ambition is to use science and innovation to solve real-world problems and contribute to a better future. Through NASA Space Apps Challenge, I hope to expand my knowledge, work with like-minded people, develop innovative solutions, and gain experience. I see this opportunity as a chance to turn my curiosity into meaningful action.
summary: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational 2D game that allows players to experience the challenges of preparing for a space mission. Players start at an astronaut training base, where an instructor guides them through their journey. They must answer science questions, make important decisions, and manage resources such as oxygen, energy, and materials. Correct answers help them earn scientific discoveries and progress through the mission.The goal of the game is to make learning about space more fun and interactive. It encourages players to think, solve problems, and discover more about science. By turning learning into a game, I hope to inspire young people to become more interested in space exploration.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a 2D educational game that lets players experience what it is like to prepare for a space mission. Players follow an instructor, answer science questions, and make decisions that affect their energy, oxygen, and materials.The goal is to make learning about space fun and interactive while encouraging curiosity and interest in science.I created the game using GDevelop on an iPad, using visual programming, animations, buttons, and variables.The creative part of the project is combining learning with gameplay. Players learn by making choices and solving challenges instead of just reading information.During development, I focused on making the game easy to use, fun, and educational for young players.
